text.text_excerpt: Let me start by saying that I am a cupcake fanatic and have tried lots of cupcakeries in the country. I would have sworn this storefront was labeled Kupcake Korner, though I'm sure whatever it's named is part of the Kupcake Factory family as the server assured us their cupcakes are baked daily from the Kenner location. Nevertheless this cupcakery was a welcome change to the French Quarter to-go dessert scene (I can only handle so many beignets at a time). I have to say that this place had the best cupcakes I've had in town. While most places tries to make flavor combinations cheap tricks like fillings and maybe frostings, this place puts efforts into their treats and offers varying cupcak...

This place is great. Situated right next to Johnny's, you can stop in after your Po boy. If there's room. There is always room for dessert. The selections change daily and they only stay open until all the cupcakes are gone, or 7pm. Which ever comes first. The chocolate strawberry was a huge, yummy hit with all. I enjoyed the Reese's and the carrot cake. No raisins, it would have been too much. Good call on the omission. The cupcakes were moist with lots of icing, which you can scrape off if you think it's too much, and are super affordable. A little over $2 for each. That's steal. Where I am from in Chicago it's close to $5, and not as yummy. Little odd though. One of the days we stopped...

Guests at my wedding FLIPPED over the Fat Elvis cupcakes. I agree that the cakes have a wee bit too much icing, but this is good when you are transporting them and half the icing gets messed up and you have to quickly reshape what is left into a presentable topping! =) Praline, Carrot, Blueberry, and the infamous Fat Elvis are my favorites. The staff is so very helpful and friendly. And they will customize icing colors and flavor combos for your next event, even on extremely short notice. Bonus!
